notes.title: Something New About Wonderland on Desktop
notes.notes:
After months of development, Wonderland on Desktop is finally complete! We’ll be bringing you a demo to try out in May. We’re thrilled to finally share a detailed introduction to the game! This announcement will briefly cover the game’s features and gameplay—let’s dive right in.

[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Wonderland on Desktop is a cozy idle farm simulation game that resides at the bottom or right side of your screen. Manage your farm effortlessly while working, studying, or gaming!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/d666e752ef0428652468e03d5dd89ab1f30aba1a.png[/img]

[h2]Unique 3D Visuals[/h2]
Unlike typical 2D farm games, Wonderland on Desktop uses a 3D perspective to deliver stunningly detailed visuals, including realistic lighting and a dynamic day-night cycle that transforms the scene as time passes. The 3D design also lets you adjust the camera angle seamlessly—use the mouse wheel to switch from a top-down view to a 45° angle, making it easy to manage your farm and admire it from every perspective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/e51aaf7e9c659a9b0318576504483e7d1d409e16.png[/img]

[h2]Rich Farm Experience[/h2]
Wonderland on Desktop offers endless farm activities with a variety of crops, flowers, trees, animals, buildings, and decorative items to explore:

[h3]Crops[/h3]
Grow over 30 types of crops, unlocked progressively as you meet conditions. They don’t just earn you coins—process them into products to fulfill other in-game needs. As the backbone of any farm game, our crops are abundant and rewarding!

[h3]Flowers[/h3]
Discover nearly 10 unique flower species. Beyond generating income and crafting materials, they’re perfect for decorating your farm and adding a touch of beauty!

[h3]Trees[/h3]
From over 20 tree varieties, harvest timber from wood trees or collect fruits from orchards—each serves a purpose in your farm’s ecosystem.

[h3]Animals[/h3]
Place animal pens and fill them with adorable critters! Raise them to enhance your farm’s vitality and resources.

[h3]Buildings[/h3]
Construct functional structures like workstations and processing machines, each operated by cute fairy “employees.” These buildings boost efficiency, craft products, and play a vital role in expanding your farm.

[h3]Decorations[/h3]
Customize your farm with a wide range of decorative items, from man-made ornaments to natural landscapes. Design a one-of-a-kind farm that reflects your style—beauty is their superpower!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/6f35657da32714999c8ff04e2c6597790ef4a63c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/9ffacd9ddd5c49a7721a98393e0954ef2dccbb49.png[/img]

[h2]User-Friendly Features[/h2]
Adjust the game window to your liking: hold the Control key and scroll the mouse wheel to resize it, whether you want a tiny sidebar companion or a larger view to appreciate the details. You can even dock the window to the right to free up screen space!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/2ff17352261786cc549b7c963b9700a5f7e21ae8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484848/726f9a04875650a6e08253ced2e4d6549addb746.png[/img]

This is just a taste of what Wonderland on Desktop offers. Experience the full demo after the holiday, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist if you’re excited!

notes.title: News about Wonderland on Desktop
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! this is secretary from Prairie Town! I'm really glad to bring you the news about Wonderland on Desktop 

In the major update of version 1.2 of Song of The Prairie, we introduced our new product, Wonderland on Desktop. Today, I would like to have a detailed chat with you about this new game and report to you on the current progress of this game:

[h2]Introduction:[/h2]
The background of Wonderland on Desktop is still in Prairie Town. However, unlike Song of The Prairie, Wonderland on Desktop aims to provide players with a more relaxed and pleasant gaming experience. The main interface of the game will only occupy a part of the bottom of the desktop. Players can study, work and entertain on the screen while taking care of their farms.

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
Wonderland on Desktop will provide you with an infinitely expandable farm. Players can freely place soil blocks on this land and then plant their favorite crops on them. Wait until the crops grow up, bear fruits and then harvest them. Whether you are a player who enjoys landscaping or a farmer obsessed with planting, I believe it can bring you satisfaction.Of course, the harvested crops can be processed into dry rations, which can then be used to exchange for and unlock more crops, bringing you even more satisfaction! At the same time, players will obtain items such as wood, stone and gold coins while playing. These can be used to unlock buildings, unopened lands, etc., so as to obtain more rewards and form a cycle! In short, there will be a lot of content in Wonderland on Desktop waiting for you to explore.

[h2]Graphics:[/h2]
The 3D graphics are also the essence of Wonderland on Desktop. Even if it only takes up a small part of the screen, Wonderland on Desktop still adopts a 3D visual effect. It's not just about the 3D graphic performance. Players can adjust the perspective at will, whether it's a front view, a top view or a 45-degree diagonal view, giving full play to the advantages of 3D. Also, due to the 3D effect, we have added real environmental lighting and lighting effects in the game. I believe these will definitely bring a better experience.

[h2]Progress Report:[/h2]
Currently, Wonderland on Desktop has been largely completed and has entered the optimization stage.

[h2]Optimization:[/h2]
Considering the graphic performance and the characteristics of the game, we have decided to change the helpers in the game into animals. Later, players will be able to see the lovely little animals busying around on the farm.

Graphic optimization: Optimization of the game graphics, color tone, lighting and other performances.

Character performance optimization: Optimization of the behaviors of characters, animals, etc.

Operation optimization.UI optimization.
